cover.kicker: 封面故事 · GitHub 项目
cover.title:
逆向工程项目 rea
连续 23 天高增长
cover.dek: morluto/rea 一天涨了 6,095 颗星，总星已到 395,650，榜上还有 4 个同主题的 awesome 清单跟着涨。X 上有人说它在 Claude 里被限制了，官方没有确认，但真实讨论量已经远超曝光。
cover.title_en:
Reverse-engineering repo rea
is on a 23-day growth streak
cover.dek_en: morluto/rea gained 6,095 stars in a day and now sits at 395,650, with four awesome-lists on the same topic rising alongside it. A rumor on X says Claude restricted it. Nothing official backs that up, but organic discussion already dwarfs the promo posts.

stickers.title: Skill 配套
stickers.text: Cloudflare 的安全审计 skill 连续 43 天上涨，NVIDIA 的 SkillSpector 日增 +815。
stickers.text_en: Cloudflare's security-audit skill has been climbing for 43 days, and NVIDIA's SkillSpector added 815 stars in a day.

stickers.title: 设计热点
stickers.text: 反 AI 味设计 Skill 走红：hallmark 日增 +2,822，ai-design-skills 一条推文就有 ❤10,173。
stickers.text_en: Anti-AI-look design skills are taking off: hallmark added 2,822 stars a day, and one ai-design-skills tweet drew ❤10,173.

stickers.title: 曝光落差
stickers.text: Agent-Reach 的曝光约是真实讨论的 22 倍，主要靠一条营销腔清单撑起来。
stickers.text_en: Agent-Reach's exposure is about 22 times its organic discussion, driven mostly by a single promotional list.
